description: This PHP source file defines the ChannelSectionAdminController class, which manages CRUD operations for channel sections within the admin interface of the Goteo project. It includes route definitions, actions for listing, adding, editing, and deleting channel sections, and interacts with models such as Node and NodeSections.

classes.name: ChannelSectionAdminController
classes.description: Controller class for managing channel sections in the admin panel, including routing, listing, adding, editing, and deleting sections.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the group name 'channels' for routing or categorization.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Defines and returns routes for the controller actions.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Displays a list of sections for a given node/channel.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new channel section.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles editing an existing channel section.

methods.name: deleteAction
methods.description: Handles deletion of a channel section.
